clips.caption: Ad: Kevin Trudeau on why the very first step toward a big goal isn't "I want" — it's a much smaller word. Would you actually say it out loud?
Ad: Kevin Trudeau on the picture you carry of yourself, and why saying something that doesn't match it creates conflict instead of results. What does your picture say?
Ad: Kevin Trudeau on why saying "I want to be a millionaire" can trigger old beliefs that fight back. Which belief about money did you grow up with?
Ad: Kevin Trudeau on repeating "I can" out loud when nobody's around — and how it starts shifting you from victim to cause. Try it today and tell me how it feels.
Ad: Kevin Trudeau on the difference between "I will" (someday) and "I am in the process" (today). What are you doing right now that proves you're in the process?
Ad: Kevin Trudeau on why "I am a millionaire" is where you finish, not where you start. Where are you on the ladder right now?
